## Problem

Describe the issue or requested improvement in one or two sentences.

## Scope

State the repository area, workflow, script, target type, or capability involved.

## Reproduction or evidence

Provide the smallest reproducible steps, relevant logs, screenshots, audit evidence, or source links. Remove secrets and personal data.

## Expected result

Describe what should happen.

## Actual result

Describe what currently happens.

## Proposed next step

If known, list the smallest safe change or investigation step.

## Verification

Describe how the fix can be proven without expanding the scope unnecessarily.
